proposals.evidence: DEDR 2674(a) lists Tamil/Malayalam/Kannada uppu, Kolami sup and Parji cup ‘salt’; subsection (b) gives Gondi havar/ovor, Konda sōru and Kuvi hāru. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
